with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

translations.web: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.
translations.bsb: While the shoots are still uncut, they dry up more quickly than grass.
translations.kjv: Whilst it is yet in his greenness, and not cut down, it withereth before any other herb.
